info.description: E-commerce REST API built with Go, Gin, GORM, JWT, and Cloudinary
info.title: Reflect Backend API

get.description: Retrieve all saved addresses for the authenticated user

post.description: Create a new shipping address for the authenticated user

delete.description: Delete a shipping address by ID

put.description: Update an existing category by ID (admin only)

delete.description: Delete a category by ID (admin only)

put.description: Update an existing collection by ID (admin only)

delete.description: Delete a collection by ID (admin only)

put.description: Update order status, payment status, and shipping status (admin only)
Update an existing product by ID (admin only)

delete.description: Delete a product by ID (admin only)

post.description: Authenticate user with email and password, returns JWT token
Create a new user account with name, email, and password

get.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's shopping cart

post.description: Add a product to the authenticated user's cart. If the product already exists, quantities are added together.

delete.description: Remove all items from the authenticated user's cart

put.description: Update the quantity of a specific item in the cart

delete.description: Remove a specific item from the cart

Retrieve a single category by its URL slug
Retrieve a single category by its UUID

Retrieve only active collections
Retrieve only featured collections

Retrieve a single collection by its UUID
Retrieve the authenticated user's profile

put.description: Update the authenticated user's profile information

Retrieve a specific order by its order number for the authenticated user

Retrieve products marked as featured

Retrieve a single user by their UUID (authenticated users can get their own)

Remove a specific item from the wishlist by its ID
